at://did:plc:su47cn47fh3e5n6zcchnyws5/ap.text: I’m exploring an interesting possibility in DOS gaming on AGP/PCI-era VGA cards: Bus-master DMA transfers of system RAM to video RAM. This lets the CPU build rows in system RAM while the card pulls in finished rows just ahead of the beam. As far as I know, no DOS game engine has done this before.
